title: Work Intelligence V2 ⇄ Trust Gateway Boundary Contract
description: Defines the only legitimate ways a Work Intelligence observation/work-item may cross into operator-facing or execution surfaces. WI is a detection layer: it detects, observes, and proposes — it possesses NO implicit execution authority. Trust Gateway is the operator-facing policy/control plane and MUST refuse to auto-execute anything originating from WI.

work_intelligence.description: WI may only detect, observe, and propose. It never executes.

trust_gateway.description: TG mediates operator policy. It must not auto-execute WI proposals.

works_execution.description: Only WORKS may execute. It accepts work-items ONLY via explicit, gated promotion.

boundary_invariants: WI possesses NO implicit execution authority: every execution path from a WI work-item requires explicit promotion gated by tenant policy (allow_works=True), work-item state APPROVED, and human review (require_approval_for_promotion=True by default).

TG MUST NOT auto-execute WI output: any WI proposal crossing into TG enters exclusively through an explicit admission surface producing an admission_record with decision=admitted-for-observation; anything else is rejected by default.

Detection results never mutate operator state implicitly: publishing to a destination requires an explicit publish action with receipt, and the destination must be in TenantPolicy.allowed_destinations.
The canonical work-item is strictly separate from executable WORKS Work objects: the engine never auto-promotes.
